title.suggested: Jem Mace Wants to Fight Tom Allen Again

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic reported that Jem Mace, close to 60, wanted to come to America and fight Tom Allen again after hearing Allen had said he could whip him; the writer doubted Allen would fare better than 25 years before.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, February 24, 1895, page 11. New York correspondence dated Feb. 22.

facts.fact: Jem Mace, close to 60, reportedly wanted to come to America to fight Allen again after being told Allen said he could whip him; informant Billy Delaney

notes: Same article as 906. Title 'Mace and Allen Championship Contest' is misleading: no contest took place.
